findings.title: Existing-user magic_create 'does not modify' tests seed nil utm, so they assert nil->nil (weak but falsifiable, not a ghost test)
findings.description: The confirmed-user and unconfirmed-user magic_create tests seed the existing user with nil utm columns, then POST utm params and assert the columns stay nil. Falsifiable against an overwrite defect (params send 'SomeRawValue'; if a branch wrongly applied utm the assertion fails), so NOT a ghost test. A stronger version would seed non-nil utm and assert preservation. Same theme as l2-r2-a14-F1 (optional test strengthening).
